page.content:
McLaren's three-time champion, killed at Imola in 1994.

How Ayrton Senna connects

  • Event: 1994 San Marino Grand Prix — Ayrton Senna was killed at the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix.
  • Faction: McLaren — Ayrton Senna won his three titles with McLaren.
  • Character: Alain Prost — Senna and Prost's McLaren years were Formula 1's defining teammate war.
  • Event: Monaco Grand Prix — Senna won the Monaco Grand Prix a record six times.

What is Ayrton Senna?

Ayrton Senna won three Drivers' Championships with McLaren, made Monaco his personal circuit, and died at the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix — a loss that remade Formula 1 safety.

Key threads lead to 1994 San Marino Grand Prix, McLaren, Alain Prost and Monaco Grand Prix.
